name: code_saturne_poiseuille
title: code_saturne: the .unv export checked end to end
headline: code_saturne 9.2.0 reads every cell and group of the .unv; laminar Poiseuille Δp converges at order 2.05 to +0.18 %

references.source: Hagen–Poiseuille: $dp/dx = 32 \nu U_b / D^2$ at the realised bulk velocity

toolchain.conversion: write() to .unv (I-DEAS universal), read by cs_preprocess

checks.import: the preprocessor's cells and hexa8 equal cell_count(), every group by name with its size: the equal tee and each Poiseuille level (recheck); groups, cell types and counts on the written file (tests/test_unv.py)
checks.exact: laminar Poiseuille at Re 100: dp/dx between 15 D and 25 D within 2 % of 32 nu U_b / D^2 at the finest level
checks.order: the Δp error's order over k = 1, 2, 3 reported (Richardson)
